The '''Abregado system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Abregado-dai]], [[Abregado-san]], [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]], [[Abregado-fus]], and [[Abregado-taki]].

==History==
Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|battle]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] and several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|warships]]. All of the Republic ships were destroyed, but several [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] were jettisoned, although only one was found by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in their search for survivors.<ref name="RM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], its location fell in the then-named "[[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]]"&mdash;a militarized zone which separated New Republic space from the fragmented [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Economically, Abregado was significant, for it possessed an advanced manufacturing infrastructure which linked the system's planets. The goods produced were considered vital by [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] restored democratic regime.<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
